description: This file contains shell functions for managing boot partitions, UUIDs, and system upgrades for imx-based hardware in OpenWrt. It provides utilities for mounting boot partitions, copying configuration files, performing upgrades, and handling backup and restore operations.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Retrieves the root partition UUID shortened by removing the '-02' suffix.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the block device associated with the partition UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Determines the partition device for the root partition based on UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device for the root filesystem partition using UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Creates /boot directory and mounts the boot partition if not already mounted.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition and copies backup configuration to it.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Mounts boot, extracts kernel and root filesystem images from the upgrade package, and replaces current images.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps to reset the overlay filesystem if no backup is specified.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves backup configuration from boot to root filesystem, if boot partition exists.
